data.name: Kevan
data.gender_notes: Kevan is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Kevan is of unknown origin but is believed to have Celtic or Old English roots. It means 'little or young warrior'. The name may also be derived from the Greek name Aevin or the Latin name Caelanus. The name Kevan carries the meaning “Little or young warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kevan usually hope their child will grow to embody little or young warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing courage, strength, and determination.
data.etymology: Kevan belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little or young warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kevan total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: קבן
in_hebrew.meaning: קבן: נולד מחדש, צעיר, רוח חדשה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: קבן הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'נולד מחדש' או 'צעיר'. הוא קשור למושגים של התחדשות ורוח חדשה. השם עשוי להיות קשור לשורש העברי 'קבה', שפירושו 'להתחדש' או 'להתעורר'. השם קבן נמצא בשימוש במסגרת השמות הנוצריים, ומבטא את הרעיון של התחדשות רוחנית ותחייה.

in_greek.name: Κέβαν
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Κέβαν είναι ελληνικό και σημαίνει 'νεογέννητος' ή 'νέος άνθρωπος'. Είναι συνδεδεμένο με την έννοια της αναγέννησης και της ανανέωσης. Στην παράδοση των ονομάτων της Εκκλησίας, το Κέβαν συμβολίζει την πνευματική αναγέννηση και τη νέα ζωή που έρχεται μέσα από την πίστη.

in_latin.name: Kevan
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Kevan origine hebraica vel graeca habet et significat 'renatus' vel 'novus homo'. In traditione christiana, Kevan exprimit ideam renovationis spiritualis et novae vitae per fidem. Nomen hoc in ecclesia primitiva in usu fuit, significans hominem novum et spiritualiter renatum.

in_english.name: Kevan
in_english.meaning: Kevan: born again, young one, new spirit

Historically used in Christian traditions, Kevan represents a new spirit and a fresh start. The name conveys a sense of youthfulness and vitality, embodying the Christian concept of being 'born again' through faith.

Ultimately, the name Kevan symbolizes the inner strength and unwavering spirit we all carry within ourselves.
